practice_questions.question_text: Explain why compressing a large diagnostic log can help when it is sent over a connection with limited bandwidth.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
practice_questions.solution: Compression encodes the log using fewer bits. At the same available bit rate, fewer bits take less time to transfer, leaving more capacity for other traffic.

marking_points.criterion: Same bit rate therefore shorter transmission time.
